items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: And so she personally invited me to come down and play at the Mother's Day program

ctx.x: And as luck would have it, she came up there during the program, and I was playing, and she seemed to have never

heard anything played quite like that. And so she personally invited me to come down and play at the Mother's Day program, much to my -- well whatever you want to call it -- because I never saw that many people in my life.
And needless to say I was perfectly petrified. I didn't know which end of the horn to blow. But some way we got through it and that was the beginning of my really, really great musical career.
